concerns.text: The 'Wikitext-2' dataset entry lists '[No verified source]' in the Source URL column. The plan requires evaluating calibration (ECE) on Wikitext-2 (Spec FR-005, US-1). Without a verified, accessible URL or HuggingFace dataset identifier, the evaluation step cannot be executed. The upstream resolver cannot validate a non-existent or unverified source, making the research plan infeasible as written.

The 'OpenWebText' entry cites a specific raw parquet file URL (Skylion007/openwebtext/...train-00000-of-00080.parquet). This URL points to a single shard of a multi-shard dataset. The plan assumes this single file is sufficient for 'Training Data' (US-1, FR-004). However, OpenWebText is a large corpus; relying on a single shard (approx. 1/80th of the data) may not provide the 'adequate training signal' mentioned in the Spec Assumptions, and the URL format suggests a direct file fetch rather than a robust dataset loader. The plan should cite the canonical HuggingFace dataset ID (e.g., 'Skylion007/openwebtext') and specify the loading logic to handle the full dataset or a defined random subset, rather than a hardcoded shard URL which may be brittle or insufficient.
